name: @amlhubs/afp
description: OMG Automated Function Points (AFP) 1.0 — formal/14-01-03 / ISO/IEC 19515:2019. IFPUG-compliant function-point sizing as a typed SMM 1.2 measurement library. Surfaces every AFP measure (FTR, DET, RET, FTR_EO, DET_EO, EOC, EOCsum, wEO, EOs, FTR_EI, DET_EI, EIC, EICSum, wEI, EIs, RET_LF, DET_LF, DFC, DFCsum, wILF, ILFs, wEIF, EIFs, AFPs), Scope (Element, EO, EI, LF, Segment), Characteristic (FunctionalMeasures, ExternalOutputSize, ExternalInputSize, InternalLogicalFileSizeAndExternaInterfaceFileSize, AutomatedFunctionPointSize, General), and KDM-recognizer Operation (isEO, getEOs, isEI, getEIs, isILF, getILFs, isEIF, getEIFs, isLF) as TypeScript instances of @amlhubs/smm metaclasses.
